the-weight-of-the-flag.title: The Weight of the Flag
the-weight-of-the-flag.summary: The first walk: green, white and red carried on three backs from San Francesco della Vigna to Zanipolo. Heads turn, a passer-by calls it a tribute to Italy, and a conversation starts in a historic square.

seven-steps-to-heaven.title: Seven Steps to Heaven
seven-steps-to-heaven.summary: A stair of seven steps that goes nowhere, carried by hand into Tesa 41 and painted white: on cubes, journeys, the present, and a climb to heaven in a small space.

italian-flag.title: The Italian Flag
italian-flag.summary: Green, white and red panels on their own feet: a flag made from the pavilion’s units, and a conversation about play, roots and carrying the flag to San Marco.

carrying.title: Carrying
carrying.summary: A red unit strapped to a back frame and carried through the Arsenale and the streets of Castello. In Venice everything moves by hand or by boat.

murano.title: Murano
murano.summary: Furnaces, glassblowers and a conversation at the table: on Murano’s glass and on keeping a studio alive rather than a showroom.

before-the-flag.title: Before the Flag
before-the-flag.summary: A white crenellated form in the hall: vertigo, scale, the roof beams of the Arsenale, and how a simple unit becomes an assembly.

tesa-41-september.title: In Tesa 41
tesa-41-september.summary: The Italian flag in its foam state, interlocking parts, pigments and brushes as the studio fills with color.

maquette.title: The Maquette
maquette.summary: From sketch to 3D model to full-scale foam: squares, rectangles and proportion, tested by standing next to the form.

leaning-red.title: Leaning Red
leaning-red.summary: Building a tall form by hand in the garden studio, from cardboard and tape to a panel standing in the room. Music only.
